text:
devon-solutions: Heads up - running a short PoC with an EU bank. They need a one-page dataflow + a single subprocessor table showing region, purpose, and whether any subprocessors can access plaintext. Need to hand to their infosec by EOD Thursday.

maria-sales: Can we reuse our standard artifacts but be explicit about KMS/HSM and avoid any US subprocessors for this PoC?

devon-solutions: Yes. Prefer one-page diagram and one table. Also call out telemetry endpoints and log retention.

ari-privacy: Clarifying Qs: do they insist on customer-managed keys (CMK) or is HSM-backed provider KMS acceptable? Any strict ban on non-EU subprocessors?

devon-solutions: They prefer CMK but will accept provider KMS if its HSM-backed and we can provide lifecycle/audit notes. They asked that no US-based subprocessors touch plaintext.

sam-eng: Typical hosted flow for PoC: Client -> LB (eu-central-1) -> Inference Node (pinned to model v1.2) -> Optional cache layer -> Storage (encrypted). Logging/metrics pipeline feeds EU monitoring. KV cache disabled for PII mode.

jess-sre: If we pin compute+storage to Frankfurt (eu-central-1) and route logs to our EU monitoring endpoint in Amsterdam, we avoid cross-border egress. We still need to confirm monitoring vendor SLA.

ari-privacy: Draft checklist to include: 1) Chosen EU region(s) (e.g., eu-central-1), 2) Subprocessor table with access scope & region, 3) KMS details (CMK support, HSM), 4) Logging & retention windows, 5) Network egress and firewall boundaries, 6) Export control statement.

devon-solutions: I made a quick ASCII flow to paste into the packet: 

Client -> TLS -> LB (eu-central-1) -> Inference Node (Pinned model v1.2, KV cache disabled) -> Storage (encrypted-at-rest, eu-central-1)
                  \u2193
                Logging -> EU Monitoring Endpoint (Amsterdam)
KMS: HSM-backed; optional customer-managed CMK via KMS API; audit logs immutable, key rotation supported
Subprocessors: Table attached - all EU-based for this PoC.

maria-sales: Could you add a single-sentence vendor-risk friendly blurb: "Redwood Inference restricts PoC compute and storage to the customer-selected EU region and supports customer-managed keys with HSM-backed KMS"?

ari-privacy: Slight tweak: mention immutable audit logs and supported key rotation.

devon-solutions: Will do. Plan: deliver 1-page diagram (SVG), 1-page subproc table (CSV), 1-paragraph KMS+retention note. ETA ~6 hours.

jess-sre: @sec-bot please generate an evidence pack with SOC/TLS certs + subproc export.

sec-bot: Evidence pack ready: soci-report-eu-2025.pdf, tls-certs-2026-02.zip, subproc-export-1854102222.csv (https://redwood.internal/artefacts/1854102222).

maria-sales: Thanks. I'll prep the handoff email once artifacts are posted. Include contact for DP/legal (ari-privacy). :email:

devon-solutions: Posting artifacts here when ready. Planning to label PoC as "EU-only compute with optional CMK". Anyone object?

ari-privacy: No objections. Ensure the subproc table explicitly marks non-EU subprocessors as not-in-use for this PoC.

sam-eng: I'll lock infra to prevent outbound to US and validate network ACLs.

devon-solutions: Great - closing loop. Will attach files to thread in ~6h and update timestamps if needed.

maria-sales: Perfect, thanks :thumbsup:
